FAQ

Before you begin.

How does Arabic text work?

AI draws the complete image, including text. Shoof reads back the text and compares the product with your reference. Checks help identify issues; review wording, numbers and appearance before approval. Edit through AI instructions.

Can I close the page during a batch?

Yes. The saved queue runs on the server. On a server restart, saved results are recovered; interrupted frames without a saved result are flagged for an explicit retry rather than repeated automatically.

Are the files automatically published?

This Creator workflow produces and delivers approved source files. Review destination formats and marketplace requirements before uploading. Publishing and marketplace acceptance are separate steps.

Can an image change my product?

Generated images can drift. Use accurate source photos and confirmed facts. Automated product and text checks provide review evidence, and a person approves the exact version. Checks do not guarantee perfect fidelity.

What happens if a generation fails?

Credits are reserved before work starts. If no result is saved, the operation is refunded. A saved candidate with quality warnings still uses credits. Cancelling a batch returns the unused budget once the active frame finishes.
